tasks.label: Haedrez: Open Messenger trial
tasks.command: if (Get-Process haedrez -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'Haedrez is already running. Exit the existing instance from its tray menu before launching this build.' } else { $app = Start-Process -FilePath '${workspaceFolder}\build\msvc\Debug\haedrez.exe' -ArgumentList '--messenger' -PassThru; if ($app.WaitForInputIdle(10000)) { Write-Output 'Messenger trial started.' } else { Write-Error 'App startup timed out.' } }
